title: Bayside Furnishings Recalls Youth Bed Toy Chests Sold at Costco After the Death of a 22-Month-Old Child
summary: The lid supports on the toy chests fail to prevent the lid from closing too quickly, posing an entrapment and strangulation hazard to young children. Units: About 9,350.

title: Black Cat® Fireworks Recalls Fireworks Due to Injury Hazard
summary: The firework can produce a loud bang and unexpectedly scatter debris, posing an injury hazard to the user and bystanders. Units: About 20,000.

title: Children's Jewelry Recalled by Bead Bazaar USA Due to Risk of Lead Exposure
summary: The children's jewelry could contain high levels of lead. Lead is toxic if ingested by young children and can cause adverse health effects. Units: About 13,000.

title: Fireworks Over America Recalls Fireworks Due to Shock Hazard

title: Outdoor Canopies Sold Exclusively at BJ's Wholesale Club Recalled by Wanda Technology Due to Fire Hazard
summary: The canopies fail to comply with a voluntary flammability standard. That could pose a fire hazard to consumers. Units: About 8,600.

title: Hayes Bicycle Group Recalls Quick-Release Devices for Bicycles Due To Fall Hazard
summary: The quick release devices can unexpectedly fail or break when locked in position on the bicycle, causing the rider to lose control, which poses a serious fall hazard. Units: About 800.

title: Paintball Gun Adapters Recalled by RAP4 Due to Impact and Laceration Hazards

summary: The snaps on these garments can detach, posing a choking hazard to young children. Units: About 6,200.

title: Redcat Racing Recalls Remote Controlled Toy Vehicles Due to Remote Control Defect
summary: The remote control unit can lose its signal, causing the toy vehicle to lose control, posing a risk of injury to the user or bystanders. Units: About 1,400.

title: All-Terrain Vehicles Recalled By American Honda Motor Co. Due to Risk of Loss of Control Hazard
summary: If the ATV's rubber CV (constant velocity) boots get punctured or torn the joint will become contaminated and severe binding of the CV joints could occur, resulting in the sudden loss of steering control. This poses a risk of injury or death to riders. Units: About 42,000.

title: Log Splitter Engines Recalled By American Honda Motor Co. Due to Fire Hazard
summary: The engine's fuel tank can crack and leak, posing a risk of fire or explosion. Units: About 5,600.

title: Studio RTA Recalls TV Stands Due to TV Tip-over Hazard
summary: The stability of the stand does not meet industry standards to prevent TV tip-over, posing a risk of injury or death to consumers. Units: About 6,700.

summary: The youth ATV lacks front brakes, a manual fuel shut-off, and padding to cover the sharp edges on the handlebar assembly. title: Bench Scale Adapters Recalled by American Weigh Scales Due to Fire Hazard
summary: The recalled bench scale adapters can smoke, catch fire and melt, posing a fire hazard to consumers. Units: About 1,300.

title: Polaris Industries Inc. Recalls Snowmobiles Due to Risk of Injury to Riders
summary: Cracks could form in the starter ring-gear and cause the ring-gear to fracture into several pieces. The broken pieces could be propelled out of the chassis of the machine at high speed, causing serious injury or death to the rider and/or bystanders. Units: About 1,360.

summary: An odorant is added to propane to help alert customers to propane leaks, but rust inside a propane tank can cause the odor to fade. title: Lawn Mowers Recalled by American Honda Motor Corp. Due to Laceration Hazard
summary: The lawn mower's rear shield can break off allowing debris to be thrown toward the operator, which poses a laceration hazard to consumers. Units: 20500.

title: Lip Gloss and Jewelry Sets Sold Exclusively at Wal-Mart Recalled by F.A.F. Inc. Due to Risk of Lead Exposure
summary: The lobster claw clasp on the bracelet contains high levels of lead, which is toxic if ingested and can cause adverse health effects. Units: 30000.

title: Parragon Books Recalls Children's Necklaces Due to Risk of Lead Exposure
summary: Solder on the charm of the necklace may contain high levels of lead, which if ingested by young children can cause adverse health effects. Units: About 500,000.

title: Shoelace and Necklace Children's Charms Recalled by Action Products International Due to Risk of Lead Exposure
summary: The clasp in the charm craft kits contains high levels of lead. Lead is toxic if ingested by young children and can cause adverse health effects. Units: 18,500 units.

title: New England Ropes Recalls Climbing Lines Due to Fall Hazard
summary: The climbing lines can break, posing a serious fall hazard for climbers. Units: About 530.

title: Wooden Toys Recalled by Earthentree Due To Choking and Strangulation Hazards
summary: The recalled toys contain small parts or can break into small parts, posing a choking hazard. The recalled rattles violate the federal rattle standard. Some of the toys also have a string longer than 12 inches, which can pose a strangulation hazard to young children. Units: About 375.

title: Children's Stuffed Toys Recalled By Daiso Due to Choking Hazard
summary: The stuffed toys contain small parts, posing a choking hazard to young children. Units: About 120,000.

title: Cost Plus Recalls Santorini Chairs Due to Fall Hazard
summary: The seat weld can fail and allow the chair to collapse, posing a fall hazard to consumers. Units: About 8,600.

title: Horseshoe Magnets Recalled by Dowling Magnets Due to Violation of Lead Paint Standard
summary: The plastic coating on the magnets contains excessive levels of lead, which violates the federal lead paint standard. Units: About 91,500.

title: Kids II Recalls Infant Rattles Due to Choking Hazard
summary: The tip of the rattle's antenna, which is attached to a bee figure, can detach and pose a choking hazard to small children. Units: About 19,000.

title: Pacific Science Supplies Recalls Magnets Due to Violation of Lead Paint Standard
summary: The paint on the magnets can contain excess levels of lead, violating the federal lead paint standard. Units: About 40,000.

title: Reebok International Ltd. Recalls Exercise Cycles Due to Laceration Hazard
summary: The alloy cranks on the exercise cycles can break during use, posing a laceration and abrasion hazard to users. Units: About 20,000.

title: Remote-Controlled Helicopter Toys Recalled by Innovage Due to Fire and Burn Hazards
summary: The rechargeable lithium ion battery inside the helicopters can overheat, catch fire, and ignite nearby combustibles, posing fire and burn hazards to consumers. Units: About 685,000.

title: Champion's Choice Recalls Walther Air Cylinders for Air Pistols Due to Burst Hazard
summary: The cylinders can burst when in use and/or while being filled, posing a risk of serious injury to consumers. Units: About 70.

title: Dirt Devil Vacuum Accessory Tools Recalled Due to Laceration Hazard
summary: Plastic pieces inside the vacuum tool can break apart and be ejected, posing a laceration hazard to consumers. Units: About 987,000.

title: Electra Bicycle Company Recalls Amsterdam Bicycles; Chain Can Derail and Pose Injury Risk to Riders
summary: The interior alignment tabs of the bicycle's chainguard can be pushed against the chain, causing it to derail, which poses a risk of injury to riders. Units: About 9,500.

title: Indoor Lighting Fixtures Recalled by Lithonia Lighting Due to Fire Hazard
summary: A thermal protector could be missing from the lighting fixtures, posing a risk of overheating and fire. Units: About 1,200.

title: It's MY Binky Recalls Personalized Pacifiers Due to Choking Hazard
summary: The pacifier button, ring handle and shield with nipple can detach, posing a choking hazard to infants. Units: About 115,000.

title: Sleep Innovations Recalls Pillows Sold Exclusively at Costco; Metal Fragments Pose Abrasion Hazard
summary: The pillows can contain small metal fragments in the fiber-fill as a result of a mechanical breakdown in the manufacturing process. The metal fragments can cause abrasions and cuts to consumers. Units: About 120,000.
